title: b7z9.88.b: Rust - root-side sign+append of the 0x17 option behind a feature flag
description: Child of b7z9.88: no stack appends the root DIO signature option to OUTGOING DIOs (Rust message.rs RootDioSignature::write_to exists with no producer; the receiver is fully wired rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:522). Deliverable: when the node is root and CONFIG/feature root-sig is enabled, the root's DIO TX path signs per python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py create_root_dio_signature (:242, the only signer) or a Rust port, and appends via RootDioSignature::write_to. Gate behind a cargo feature (name it lichen-rpl-root-sig or match the C Kconfig name for cross-stack clarity). Add an outgoing-shape test asserting the receiver's own verify path accepts the appended option (round-trip).
